Hi @Akasurde,

I pushed a PR here https://github.com/Akasurde/ansible/pull/9 to fix/improve the test-suite. And I discovered the module is not idempotent. You cannot run to time a `vmware_object_rename` task, the second time we get a failure like this one: `"msg": "Failed to find object 'DC0' with 'Datacenter' object type"`. IMO, if a target with new name already exists and we source is missing, the module should just return: `changed==false`.
Any update on this new feature of renaming local datastore on Esxi host? When can we except it to merge?

Could you please reopen the PR there?

issue_context.title: VMware: rename_vm works only with uuid
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY
rename_vm functionality works only with uuid. [rename_task](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/a79f7e575a9576f804007ed979aa6c1aa731dd2d/lib/ansible/modules/cloud/vmware/vmware_guest.py#L2536) and name param is used for new_name. 

uuid is not obvious param for all users and name is used to get existing VM.

Can we introduce new argument 'new_name' use name param as well to rename the VM?

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
vmware_guest

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```
ansible 2.10.0.dev0
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/vmware/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /home/vmware/Ansible/ansible/lib/ansible
  executable location = /home/vmware/Ansible/ansible/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.5.2 (default, Nov 17 2016, 17:05:23) [GCC 5.4.0 20160609]
```

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
```
- name: Rename a virtual machine (requires the virtual machine's uuid)
  vmware_guest:
    hostname: "{{ vcenter_hostname }}"
    username: "{{ vcenter_username }}"
    password: "{{ vcenter_password }}"
    validate_certs: no
    uuid: "{{ vm_uuid }}"
    name: new_name
    state: present
  delegate_to: localhost
```

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
name: should be existing vm name
new_name: for new name for VM

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
```
module takes 'name' argument for new_name and uuid to identify existing vm

```

needs_info

Since `vmware_guest` is already packed with a bunch of features, I took the liberty to create a new generic module for renaming VMware objects.

Thanks.

review_comments: The valid options can be mentioned under `choices` key like mentioned here - https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/2.3/dev_guide/developing_modules_documenting.html

I am aware that `choices` key available but Object types are dynamically populated from VMware APIs since I didn't want to hard code the values. This line is for user information only.

So the idea is if VMware adds a new object in the future, I don't need to update this block code. Just documentation update will suffice in that case.
Do we support renaming multiple objects at once?

No. Adding the facility of renaming multiple objects would increase the complexity of the module unnecessarily. This would reduce the maintainability of the code. 
I would like to keep this as is.
Can we have examples couple of other objects like Datacenter, Folder, cluster?
